name: Google Site Review
description: Displays live Google (business) reviews on the site.
project_description:
Google Review Block 

 This module allows you to display Google reviews on your Drupal website. This is very useful for restaurants, retail stores, franchisees, real estate firms, hotels and hospitality, and any other business with a website and reviews on Google.

 For a full description of the module, visit the project page .

 Submit bug reports and feature suggestions, or track changes in the issue queue .

 Back to top 

 Requirements
 
 This module requires no modules outside of Drupal core.

 Back to top 

 Installation
 
 Install as you would normally install a contributed Drupal module. For further information, see Installing Drupal Modules .

 Back to top 

 Configuration
 
 This module has no configuration.
